answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim at generating full-length sonnets that are logically and aesthetically coherent, without training on poetic texts.

answer_2.quote: we propose to evaluate the generated poems in two novel aspects: format and novelty. Format Checking ... Novelty ...

answer_4.quote: Considering the expertise required to appreciate sonnets, we recruit 6 professionals that hold a bachelor's degree in English literature or related majors as domain experts to annotate the generated sonnets.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate each poem on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very) on the following criteria: 1) Discourse Coherence ... 2) Originality/Creativity ... 3) Poetic in language ... 4) Emotion Evoking ... At last, we ask the annotators to judge if the sonnet is written by a poet ...
